description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom database change set for inserting core concept map types into the database, including methods for batch insertion, setup, and validation.

classes.name: AddConceptMapTypesChangeset
classes.description: A class implementing a custom Liquibase task to add concept map types into the database, with configurable visible and hidden types.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the batch insert of concept map types into the database.

methods.name: runBatchInsert
methods.description: Handles the batch insertion logic, including transaction management and error handling.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Executes an SQL query to retrieve an integer value from the database.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the type arrays from configurable string parameters.

methods.name: setVisibleConceptMapTypes
methods.description: Setter for the visible concept map types string.

methods.name: setHiddenConceptMapTypes
methods.description: Setter for the hidden concept map types string.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the completion of the insertion process.
